Message:
Every year, the people of this city
hold a ritual ceremony
to mourn the dead.

There, it is tradition for the one
who bears the name “Primavera”
to offer a song in the city square
to pacify the souls
of the departed...

But, the song offered
by each “Primavera” differs
depending on the songstress.
While some songs
pray for a bright future,
others are songs of sorrow
grieving those
who have been lost...

...! Ah, no, I mustn’t!
There I go again,
only ever trying to
follow in her footsteps...

As I am “Primavera” now,
I must sing with my own sound...!

...Oh...? What was that just now...?
It feels as though the sound of
someone in despair
is being carried on
the damp lake breeze...

If I remember right,
over there is...a hidden reef...

I believe there was
a great drowning accident
at that reef in the past...

Are the souls of
those who drowned there...
calling for me...?
